title: kernel/compute-efficiency push under the cache-fit law

research.literature: llama.cpp/ggml CPU decode is DRAM-bandwidth-bound (int8 DP4A optimal for M=1; repack/tiled kernels worth ~1.0x on decode because weights stream from DRAM)
research.regime_inversion: our law keeps weights L3-resident (ws 49.8% of L3) so DRAM ~0 B/token -> decode is compute-bound; the metric is integer MAC throughput, not bandwidth; this regime is unreachable without cache-fit
research.kernel_audit: dot_i8 converted int8->float (cvtepi8_epi32+cvtepi32_ps) then FMA: measured 240 ps/MAC float vs int kernel 60 ps/MAC @c=396 (float path = 3.3% of AVX2 int peak); dot_i8 verified arithmetically correct (36/36)

changes: gemv: per-input int8 activation quant (max/127, AVX2 vectorized, amortized across all rows) + integer dot idot_i8 (vpmovsxbw sign-extend + vpmaddwd, 4-accumulator 64-wide loop + SIMD hsum) + row prefetch r+1; float fallback retained for cols>512
attention scores: per-head int8 query quant + idot_i8 against int8 K (was scalar float with per-elem i8->f32)
attention values: AVX2 float accumulation over 16-wide i8->f32 chunks, register-accumulated per head (was scalar)
softmax/sigmoid: vectorized degree-7 exp poly (expf256, range-reduced k*ln2 + Horner) 8-wide; head softcap tanh via exp identity, 8-wide
TSC profiling counters (cf_cyc_*) printed as us_tok in bench output (N=1 timing reference)

profile_us_per_token.note: revealed attention scalar loops = 58% of token time

sustained_60s_N4.note: run1 included a 695ms OS outlier; both runs reported, median-of-2 = 2.15x

G5_c_law.note: footprint unchanged; cache-fit law still holds (gate2 PASS)
G5_c_law.interpretation: 2.03x = clean(3405.1) vs CONCURRENT 64MB eviction-stream agent(1680.9) - resilience under noisy-neighbor memory pressure (L3 pollution + bandwidth contention), not the pure cache-fit effect; historical range 1.59x-2.2x. Pure isolated cache-residency benefit = 1.15x (cold_warm_clflush).

N=8 reps spread 917-2561 tok/s (2.8x) across the session - background interference; median recorded

sustained_60s_scaling.protocol: 60 s sustained, stage_rt bench, K=1, same binary (r+1 prefetch), ascending N, val.bin; accepted run = passes contamination rule (mean/p50 <= 1.10 or max <= 100 ms); rejected runs re-run once
sustained_60s_scaling.shape: flat N<=4 = K=1 single-stream structural ceiling (phase-1/4 shape reproduced); N=8 SMT knee 0.67x; all accepted runs mean/p50<=1.10 or max<=100ms

cold_warm_clflush.protocol: N=1 single thread (no MT interference); clflush model weight buffer (m.size, 64B lines) + sfence before every cold forward, flush excluded from timed region; identical 900-token reset cadence + prompt in both arms (position-matched); per-rep rdtsc + batch timing agree; 4 runs

aggregate.bw_note: naive_bytes_div_exposed_us_gb_s is NOT a bandwidth measurement: the 1.87 MB refill streams largely overlapped under GEMV compute (gemv consumes ~15 GB/s, at/below the measured 14.84-17.7 GB/s DRAM stream); the measured quantity is the exposed, unoverlapped residual penalty only

cold_warm_clflush.key_finding: cold penalty = exposed unoverlapped refill residual (+35 us median in gemv bucket only; attention/KV buckets unchanged, KV not flushed). Cache-fit benefit isolated here is 1.15x (quiet single core, weights-only eviction). Fully L3-evicted decode still ~3861 tok/s = 77x floor. NOT a bandwidth number - see bw_note.

multistream_scaling.protocol: 60 s sustained, K>1 streams, median of 3 runs per config, same binary as K=1 table; queue-wait inflates K>1 p99 structurally (multiple tokens in flight)
multistream_scaling.saturation: K=8 @ N=4 = 5744 vs K=4 @ N=4 = 5997 (0.96x) -> K=N saturates; deeper queues do not add
multistream_scaling.conclusion: multi-stream is where multi-core scaling unlocks; K=1 flat N<=4 is structural (single token in flight)

model_126_rebench.finding: 12.6M model = 333% of L3 (non-resident): run-to-run spread 2x (275-540 tok/s) tracks memory contention (gemv 1371-2950 us). Integer kernel lifts the compute term (old float kernel peaked at 275) but the DRAM term is unchanged - this is the regime cache-fit removes, and why cache-fit (1.15x isolated) matters more than kernel work for resident models.

cache_fit_benefit_claims.true_baseline_1_15x: isolated clflush cold/warm, quiet single core, weights-only, position-matched: run-median ratio 1.148 - THE baseline cache-fit claim
cache_fit_benefit_claims.resilience_2_03x: gates gate2 concurrent 64MB eviction agent - noisy-neighbor/memory-hungry core; label it resilience-under-pressure, not cache-fit benefit

doc_reconciliation.structural_ceiling: K=1 flat N<=4 = pipeline serialization (one token in flight); multi-core speedup strictly requires K>1 or speculation - THINKING 3 updated, K>1 measured in multistream_scaling
doc_reconciliation.refill_bw_correction: +35 us = exposed unoverlapped penalty in gemv, not raw DRAM throughput; naive 56 GB/s exceeds measured 14.84-17.7 GB/s DRAM stream - overlap is the finding, not bandwidth
